name: Mobile SHORAD (generic)
note: Generic mobile short-range air-defence (SHORAD) system - a representative stand-in rather than a specific vehicle. Figures are modelling estimates for a modern gun/missile SHORAD in the class of Pantsir-S1, Tor-M2 or the US IM-SHORAD (short-range SAM plus an autocannon, on a mobile chassis with its own search radar). All values are placeholders.
